subject: MAP: Reprofile + contingency lanes after evaluation delay
messages:
From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@acme.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procureops@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: evaluation hold — SOC2 evidence outstanding

Hi Rafael / Laura,

Quick update from our side: the security review hit a hard stop yesterday when our InfoSec team requested the SOC 2 evidence pack and the runbook for live-data retention. They flagged two items that need clarification before they sign off the eval gate — one around KV cache persistence and another about audit log retention windows. Our procurement team is reluctant to move the PO to approval until InfoSec greenlights the pilot.

This means our originally discussed close of 2026-07-14 is at risk; realistically we're looking at a 2–3 week shift unless we can provide the artifacts and a short-term mitigation plan.

Attached: evaluation_findings.pdf (summary from Acme InfoSec)

Can your team confirm an ETA for the SOC pack and whether Redwood can offer a temporary isolation/workflow that addresses audit log retention while we complete the full data handling attestation?

Thanks,
Lina Torres
Director, Platform Engineering
Acme Corp

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@acme.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: evaluation hold — SOC2 evidence outstanding

Lina — thanks for the heads up and for the PDF. Sorry to hear it hit a hard stop. We've pulled the security and product teams into a quick sync. Two immediate things from our side: 

1) SOC pack ETA: we can provide the SOC 2 evidence bundle and runbook excerpts by EOD tomorrow (2026-07-02). That will include the KV cache persistence policy and audit log retention matrix.

2) Contingency lane: we propose a temporary deployment profile (MAP_priority_lane.docx) that pins evaluation traffic to an isolated tenant with audit-forwarding to your SIEM. That avoids changes to your long-term data retention while the attestation completes. It is gated and reversible.

I'm attaching a first-pass MAP_v2.xlsx that re-prioritizes the evaluation plan into three lanes: 
- Lane A: Immediate pilot (isolated tenant, minimal data retention, 48-hour retention window)
- Lane B: Full-featured pilot once SOC evidence is accepted
- Lane C: Deferred integration (if procurement requires commercial-level guarantees)

If Acme can accept Lane A on a limited basis we'll target a revised close of 2026-07-28. If not, we should plan for a 3–4 week rebaseline.

I'm happy to jump on a call with InfoSec tomorrow at 10am PT to walk through the artifacts.

Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx, MAP_priority_lane.docx

—Rafa
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0196

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Torres <lina.torres@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2026 14:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: evaluation hold — SOC2 evidence outstanding

Rafael / Lina —

Thanks Rafael for the proposal. Couple of tactical asks from my side: 

- Can we tighten Lane A's retention window to 24 hours for the pilot (we can still keep the audit-forwarding to their SIEM)? That will make it easier for InfoSec to accept a limited pilot.
- Suggest we add an explicit two-week contingency buffer in MAP_v2 to account for procurement gating. That makes the revised close date conservative and reduces churn for the sales and CS teams.

Marissa — can you confirm the engineering ETA on producing the SOC snippets Rafael mentioned?

Laura Bennett
Director, Growth Accounts | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@acme.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procureops@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: evaluation hold — SOC2 evidence outstanding

Thanks — 24 hours retention for Lane A is ideal. Procurement (cc'd) also asked whether Redwood would consider a short commercial concession (one-time credit) if the close moves beyond the original date due to discovery holds. They asked me to surface that as part of our go/no-go discussion tomorrow.

Procurement contact: Marco Diaz <marco.diaz@acme.com>

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Torres <lina.torres@acme.com>, Acme Procurement <procureops@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Jul 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Escalation: MAP reprofile and ask for executive approval (credit + priority lane)

Team — I am escalating this thread because Acme's procurement asked for a commercial concession tied to the evaluation delay and InfoSec has a hard stop without the SOC artifacts. Summary below: 

- Background: Pilot close originally targeted for 2026-07-14. InfoSec requested SOC 2 evidence and audit-runbook excerpts which paused procurement.
- Proposed mitigation: Lane A (isolated tenant, 24-hour retention, audit-forwarding) — allows an immediate pilot while we deliver the SOC pack.
- Timeline: SOC pack delivered by EOD 2026-07-02 (we have the engineering commit), Lane A pilot start target 2026-07-06 if Acme approves.
- Ask: Approve a one-time 10% credit against the initial month (commercial concession) and priority technical onboarding to meet the 2026-07-06 pilot start. Credit is requested by Acme if final close slips past 2026-07-14 due to discovery.

Attachments: procurement_term_sheet.pdf (procurement asked us to review terms)

If we can sign off on the credit and commit engineering priority for the week of 7/6, I will confirm Lane A with Acme and they will re-open procurement. If not, we should rebaseline close to 2026-08-04 and notify CS/finance.

Please reply with APPROVE / DENY / NEEDS DISCUSSION. I'll follow up with a short exec-sync if needed.

—Rafa
